cameraRoll.q: Is this replacing my camera roll?
cameraRoll.a: No. The shared album lives here so everyone can grab what they want. The keepers go into your gallery. This is not meant to be your main photo storage.

ios.a: If everyone in the room owns an iPhone, sure. We don't refuse friendship with Android users. And we're cloud-first: the album lives online, you pull the keepers into your gallery.

others.q: Aren't there other apps for this purpose?
others.a: We're not pretending there aren't. There are others that already do some version of this. The interesting question is why most people still dump the night in a group chat.

join.a: You share an invite link or a QR code. They join on iOS or Android, and the photos are there. Only people you invite see the album. Not the rest of the internet.
